sessions.session_description: Passive ICMS recording in primary somatosensory cortex (trunk). No behavioral task — head-fixed mouse received 3-burst stim trains while extracellular activity was recorded. Data origin: SurveyData.
sessions.experiment_description: Behavioral and electrophysiological investigation of cortical plasticity induced by repeated ICMS in primary somatosensory cortex (S1-trunk). Mice were trained on an ICMS-cued wheel-turn detection task while multi-channel extracellular recordings were collected via chronic 32-channel linear NET probes.
